value.rationale: The all-field, all-offset classification answers a natural simultaneous polynomial-prime counting problem on the characteristic-three Artin-Schreier coefficient stratum. The affine-rank distinction between collinear and independent triples is nontrivial and yields different exact counts. The sharp positive-count threshold |H|≤2q/3, uniqueness of extremal configurations, and their exact count q/3 give a complete structural boundary. It is not a finite-table increment or direct preexisting full-cubic twin formula.
